reviews.text:
When they talk about bloodline family, they aren’t joking! I had my chest and upper back done with Kadech, and I couldn’t be happier with the results.

Highly recommend!!! I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Josh Brown
reviews.text:
My experience with the team at bloodline tattoo Bali was flawless. From initial enquiry, to booking, consultation, getting my work done & the hospitality… incredible.

Kaos and John looked after me in shop and helped with any questions I had, making feel at home.

Bagas, my artist completed my entire back piece over 4 days with world class skill, going over my unique design during our initial consult to make sure my ideas and his flowed together.

Will 100% be back for more, a very professional studio which you can trust.

reviews.author: Blake Dodz
reviews.text: Went there for my first tattoo very good place the way they communicated was great definitely recommend going.

reviews.author: Wez Marlow
reviews.text:
First of all the back and forth messaging was awesome, very prompt, very honest and very helpful.
Upon entering the studio you are greatly welcomed which straight away gives you a sense of surety and a calming feeling and a knowing that you are in good hands.
I personally got a cover up done, in the consult I spoke to the artist for about 29 mins about roughly what I wanted and he was very reassuring. The next day the design he come up over night was undeniable. Blew my mind.
The day of the tattoo was a long day but the artist was respectful of when and if I needed a 10 min break which I think is important with any tattoo
The end result was phenomenal, to say these guys are a professional outfit is an understatement.
I am very happy I chose Bloodline Tattoo and I am stoked to forever be apart of the Bloodline Family.

reviews.author: Eddy Davies
reviews.text: Amazing service and very clean place. My artist (Core) has amazing attention to detail. Couldn’t recommend these guys more, will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ben W
reviews.text:
Couldn’t recommend bloodline more highly. From start to finish the experience was nothing but professional, everything from hygiene, care from both the managers/ artist/ staff was second to none.

Of all my experiences in tattoo shops this one was top tier and will only get work done here in the future.

Big mention to the artist Joe for the care and effort he took in my piece, absolute expert in his craft. Along side making the experience nothing but an easy and enjoyable time.

reviews.author: Seamus Crossan
reviews.text:
Couldn’t be happier with the guys at bloodline, very professional and friendly service with some incredible artists , highly  recommend this service if your choosing a tattoo shop in Bali
Chatting with other customers in store , everyone was so happy with their new pieces and Quilty of the artists work

reviews.author: Taylor Horn
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Bloodline Tattoo highly enough. When my original artist had to cancel unexpectedly, the team handled everything with complete professionalism and was able to get me booked in with another artist right away

My artist Kadek was absolutely incredible from start to finish. During the consultation I gave him just a few ideas and he translated it into a creative design that exceeded my expectations. His skill carried right through to the final touches, and the finished result is honestly beyond what I had imagined.
I couldn’t be happier with how it turned out.

If you’re looking for a studio that combines genuine professionalism with exceptional artistic talent, Bloodline has you covered.

reviews.author: Joey Bull
reviews.text:
I recently had my full sleeve and full chest done by Gun at Bloodline Tattoo Bali, and I honestly couldn’t be happier. I’m not usually one to leave reviews, but these guys truly deserve it.

From the first message, through the consultation, and all the way to the final session, everything was handled with professionalism and care. The quality of their work is outstanding, and the attention to detail really shows.

They also helped me fix a previous chest tattoo that was done elsewhere, turning it into something I’m genuinely proud to wear. The end result is a complete masterpiece.

If you’re thinking about getting a tattoo in Bali, I highly recommend Bloodline Tattoo. You definitely get what you pay for — and it’s worth every cent compared to the cheap, dodgy work you might regret later.

reviews.author: Cruz Mifsud
reviews.text: Got some work done past 2 days i genuinely think it’s the best tattoo shop in the world. Their work is fantastic and the service is just amazing. Getting to know people from all around the world for the past 2 days sitting in pain together it’s like one big family can’t wait to be back for more ink. This is my second time I’ve come to bloodline can’t see myself going anywhere else thank u to agung for all my work could not be happier. And all staff are incredible. Nothing better than getting a tattoo and it feels like home.

reviews.text: Was a great experience from the consultations to getting tattooed. It was a very comfortable experience and was a very hygienic studio. The artist was very unique with his design but also brought my idea to life in a way i was very happy and surprised about. Will definitely come back in the near future.

reviews.author: Alvin Lee
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Bloodline Tattoo Bali. The studio was professional, clean, and the atmosphere was very welcoming from the moment I walked in. I was greeted by Mat confirming my appointment and immediately everyone knows my name, and everyday they greet you by your name, this warms my heart.

My tattoo artist Gun is an incredible artist. His work is extremely detailed and you can really see the skill and experience in his tattooing. He took his time to make sure everything looked perfect and the final result turned out even better than I expected. I had a great time chatting with him as well, i will be returning for his work, incredible. I did a full back for my first tattoo and he make it bearable for me, never regretted choosing bloodline bali.

I also want to thank Ricky, Gun’s assistant, who was very helpful throughout the whole process. He made sure everything stayed clean, helped with the setup, and took great care when cleaning my tattoo. His support made the whole session much smoother and more comfortable.

Overall, the team at Bloodline Tattoo Bali is very professional and passionate about their work. I highly recommend this studio to anyone looking for high-quality tattoos in Bali. I’ll definitely be coming back again.

reviews.author: Alessandro Rechichi
reviews.text: Just finished a sleeve and couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. The detail, shading and flow of the design all came together perfectly. Huge thanks to the artist for the patience and skill that went into every session. Definitely worth the hours in the chair!

reviews.text: Very happy with the result. Very professional from start to finish. Communication is exceptional. Highly recommend Bloodline. I have used Bloodline in both Bali and Phuket

I’m extremely happy with the result and would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Josh Fitzpatrick
reviews.text:
Have been here a couple of times now and the service and communication has been excellent from the beginning. Adi has done amazing job everytime. Each time I shared my idea with Adi, showed him a photo or two and he brought it to life.
Cant recommend bloodline and Adi enough.

reviews.author: Jamie Erving
reviews.text:
Have been following Bloodlines work for almost 10 years, and watching the studios reputation grow each and every time I see their work on socials just solidified that I had to get tattooed by them.

From enquiries about availability to arranging deposits, consultations and working with the artists to achieve what I wanted. The process was seamless. Every employee there makes you feel like family and every artist treats you like you've known them for years.
The systems Bloodline have in place for getting ideas from your head to works of art on your body is unlike anything I've experienced. Myself and others at the studio all agree, well never be going anywhere else to get work done in the future.

The quality of the work is top notch, cleanliness of the studio is perfect. They help you with meals during the day, and ensure you're set up to be comfortable when you go home in the evening with aftercare and immaculate cleaning of the tattoo.

The location of the Bali studio is also amazing. Access to whatever you need within minutes walk.

My artist Bayu did an amazing job and I can't wait to come back for my next piece.

Thanks Bloodline

reviews.author: Dean
reviews.text:
I cannot speak highly enough of my experience at Bloodline.
I had an existing shoulder tattoo that I wanted to incorporate into a full arm sleeve. After asking around and doing my research it was pretty clear that Bloodline was the place to go.
And they didn't disappoint.
What I encountered was a thoroughly professsional, supportive, and welcoming environment with great communication and incredibly talented artists.
My artist, Mario, took my design concept and elevated it into a piece of art that he then went and executed to perfection. He was able to blend the new design into my original tattoo so seamlessly that you would think it was all done as one peice at the same time.
The end result is amazing and more than I could of envisioned or hoped for. Thank you Mario!
There is a reason that Bloodline have so many repeat customers and that you need to book in advance.
It's because they are exceptional.
So, if your looking for a quality piece of personally designed art that you can be truly proud of, then you can't go past the incredible team at Bloodline.

reviews.author: Kain Wiles
reviews.text: Just finished up an arm sleeve with Ano at bloodlines. Ano was really patient with my ideas and references in the designs stages, His final design flowed perfectly together and exceeded my expectations. He was super friendly and easy to approach through out the whole process as well. The shop is clean, hygienic and has no ego attached, everyone is great to deal with. Quality for price is unmatched to anywhere else.

reviews.author: Saxon Mcnay
reviews.text: Highly recommend, top quality service! Top quality tattoos! Very professional in what they do and definitely make their customers feel welcomed!. If there’s any questions or you need help with anything at all in the shop the lads will sort you out no problem at all. I will be definitely coming back 👍👌

reviews.text: I recently completed a full back tattoo at Bloodline Tattoo, done over four days, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. I’ll definitely be coming back in the future and would highly recommend Bloodline Tattoo and Ano to anyone looking for high-quality tattoo work.

Love this shop and highly recommend everyone wanting big or small art to come here.

reviews.text: I’ve gotten tattooed at this studio twice now — the first time was a five-day session and the second time was nine days — and both experiences were absolutely incredible. What really sets this place apart, though, is the atmosphere. The entire staff makes you feel welcome from the second you walk in. It doesn’t feel like just a tattoo studio, feels more  like a family. They go out of their way to make sure you’re comfortable, taken care of, and enjoying the process. Couldn’t be more satisfied with my experience at Bloodline.

reviews.author: Jonathan Tatmihalis
reviews.text: best tattoo experience the world has to offer, the friendliness is overwhelming from the second you open the door and the quality of tattoos is out of this world. 100% recommend anyone coming to bali chooses bloodline

reviews.author: azza wannahockalugy
reviews.text: Top quality artists, hygiene standards were perfect and will absolutely be returning for more. Great people, great vibe and stunning artwork.

reviews.author: Johnnie Singh
reviews.text: Very professional, artwork by tattoo artist was beyond my expectations. Can’t wait for my next full sleeve. Definitely would recommend if anyone getting a tattoo, try it once you will never regret.

reviews.author: Jared Gohier
reviews.text: This was the best experience I’ve had with any of my tattoos, the owners are Aussie and review every design and make sure there’s no language miscommunication, the blokes really know what they’re doing, everyone in the shop was super nice and welcoming I would 100% go back next time

reviews.author: Sharp Tooth Tackle
reviews.text: Awesome work from Bloodline. Ano_Bloodline did an amazing job on my arm sleeve. He was also awesome to deal with. Bloodline is the best forget the rest.

reviews.author: Josh Coleman
reviews.text: Unbelievable experience at Bloodline Bali today and yesterday.  The detail and effort put into the designs and cleaniness of the shop was top notch!  Highly recommend to anyone visiting to head there best around 🔥
